strings.prompt.limit: A room holds up to 16 items and 3 pieces of text. I trimmed the suggestion to fit.
strings.preview.applied.title: Applied
strings.preview.applied.body: Applied changes can't be undone. Your partner's screen updates as soon as it syncs.
strings.preview.warn.limit: There are too many items, so a few are left out.
strings.preview.warn.protected: Items that covered the buttons or the day counter were moved automatically.
strings.preview.expiring: The session ends in {s}s. If you don't apply, only the preview remains.
strings.preview.apply.err.title: Couldn't apply it
strings.preview.apply.err.body: The room hasn't changed. Please try again.
strings.preview.model.err: Something went wrong while creating the preview. The room hasn't changed.
strings.preview.conflict.title: The room just changed
strings.preview.conflict.body: We loaded the latest room. Please create the preview again.
strings.chat.applied.body: The room changed for both of you. You can undo it until you close this chat.
strings.chat.takeover.note: {name} made this preview. Applying changes the room for both of you.
strings.preview.cancel.toast: Closed without applying. Your room stays the same.
strings.prompt.msg.status.cancelled: {name} closed it without applying. The room stays the same.
